UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Stores user profile information, excluding sensitive authentication credentials, and defines user roles and personal settings.

id.description: Unique identifier for the UserProfile entity.

email.description: The user's email address, used for communication and linking to an external authentication system.

firstName.description: The first name of the user.

lastName.description: The last name of the user.

role.description: The role assigned to the user, determining their permissions within the application (e.g., 'admin', 'standard', 'viewer').

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the user profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the user profile was last updated.

Tool.title: Tool
Tool.description: Represents a single tool or resource available in the TOOLROOM2.0 catalog, including its details and categorization.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Tool entity.

name.description: The common name of the tool or resource.

description.description: A detailed description of the tool, used by the AI assistant for intelligent categorization and tagging.

manufacturer.description: The manufacturer or vendor of the tool.

modelNumber.description: The specific model number or product identifier of the tool.

serialNumber.description: A unique serial number for an individual physical tool item, if applicable.

imageUrl.description: URL to an image of the tool for visual identification in the catalog.

quantity.description: The number of units of this tool currently available in the inventory.

location.description: The physical or digital location where the tool can be found or accessed.

categoryId.description: Reference to the Category this tool belongs to. (Relationship: Category 1:N Tool)

tagIds.description: References to Tags associated with this tool for advanced filtering and search. (Relationship: Tag N:N Tool)

addedByUserId.description: Reference to the UserProfile who added this tool to the catalog. (Relationship: UserProfile 1:N Tool)

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the tool record was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the tool record was last updated.

Category.title: Category
Category.description: Defines logical groupings for tools, aiding in organization and discoverability.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Category entity.

name.description: The name of the tool category (e.g., 'Hand Tools', 'Software Development', 'Measuring Devices').

description.description: A brief description explaining the purpose or scope of the category.

Tag.title: Tag
Tag.description: Provides keywords or labels for tools, enabling flexible filtering and search capabilities.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Tag entity.

definition.description: Stores individual user profile data. Access is primarily path-based (users own their profile) with admin override. Includes a 'role' field for application logic, but admin authorization in rules relies on the '/roles_admin/{userId}' collection. Includes denormalized 'id' field which matches the {userId} wildcard.

params.name: userId
params.description: The unique Firebase Authentication UID of the user whose profile is being stored/accessed.

definition.description: Represents a single tool in the TOOLROOM2.0 catalog. All authenticated users can read. Only users with the 'admin' role (as defined in '/roles_admin') can create, update, or delete tools. The 'addedByUserId' field is for audit, not primary authorization. Includes denormalized 'id' field which matches the {toolId} wildcard.

params.name: toolId
params.description: The unique identifier for a specific tool.

definition.description: Defines categories for tools. All authenticated users can read. Only users with the 'admin' role (as defined in '/roles_admin') can create, update, or delete categories. Includes denormalized 'id' field which matches the {categoryId} wildcard.

params.name: categoryId
params.description: The unique identifier for a tool category.

definition.description: Defines tags for tools. All authenticated users can read. Only users with the 'admin' role (as defined in '/roles_admin') can create, update, or delete tags. Includes denormalized 'id' field which matches the {tagId} wildcard.

params.name: tagId
params.description: The unique identifier for a tool tag.

definition.description: A dedicated collection for Database-Backed Access Control (DBAC) to identify administrators. The existence of a document for a given 'userId' implies admin status. This collection is for security rule checks, adhering to the 'existence over content' principle for global roles. Documents in this collection can be minimal (e.g., `{ active: true }`).

params.name: userId
params.description: The unique Firebase Authentication UID of a user who holds the 'admin' role.

firestore.reasoning:
The recommended Firestore structure for TOOLROOM2.0 prioritizes secure, scalable, and debuggable access control by strictly adhering to the core design principles, especially Authorization Independence and Structural Segregation.

1.  **Authorization Independence & QAPs:**
    *   **User Profiles (`/user_profiles/{userId}`):** User-specific data is stored in a path-based ownership model (`/user_profiles/{userId}`). A user can read/update their own profile by matching `request.auth.uid` with `{userId}`. This makes authorization atomic and does not require `get()` calls to other documents for a user to manage their own data. For administrators to list all users, the system leverages the explicit `roles_admin` collection for an existence check, which acts as a secure 'admin' gate for broader read/write permissions across the collection. This allows `list` queries on `/user_profiles` to be secure and efficient for admins, returning all documents without rule-based filtering issues (QAPs).
    *   **Global Entities (`/tools/{toolId}`, `/categories/{categoryId}`, `/tags/{tagId}`):** These collections are designed for global access patterns. All authenticated users have read access to these collections, meaning `list` operations (QAPs) are fully supported and will return all documents they are authorized to see (which is everything). Write, update, and delete operations on these global entities are restricted to users with an 'admin' role, determined by an existence check against the `/roles_admin/{userId}` collection. This completely avoids `get()` calls to other documents (e.g., a user's profile document) for authorization, ensuring authorization independence for these critical, shared resources.
    *   **Admin Roles (`/roles_admin/{userId}`):** This collection is a dedicated, existence-based role store. The presence of a user's UID as a document in this collection (`exists(/roles_admin/$(request.auth.uid))`) directly confers 'admin' privileges in security rules. This is the purest form of Authorization Independence for global roles, as it's an atomic check without content dependency or traversal of the main data hierarchy.

2.  **Structural Segregation:** Each collection (`user_profiles`, `tools`, `categories`, `tags`, `roles_admin`) maintains a homogeneous security posture. For example, all `Tool` documents share the same read/write rules (global read, admin write). There are no mixed access requirements within a single collection (e.g., public vs. private tools), which simplifies security rules significantly and enhances clarity of intent.

3.  **DBAC (Database-Backed Access Control):** User roles are managed within the database. The `UserProfile.role` field provides application-level role information, while the `roles_admin` collection provides a granular, performance-optimized, and secure mechanism for authorization rule checks for global administrative privileges.
